reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Ingester configuration `max_transfer_retries` is removed: The setting `max_transfer_retries` (`-ingester.max-transfer-retries`) is removed in favor of the…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: superseded-upstream

consequence.statement: The max_transfer_retries setting, used to transfer chunks to new ingesters during rolling restarts, is removed; the Write Ahead Log (WAL) replaces it, so verify the WAL covers your rolling-restart use.

proposed.statement: The ingester setting max_transfer_retries (-ingester.max-transfer-retries) is removed in favor of the Write Ahead Log (WAL).
